# Test that static output carries the files pages point at. Rendering
# writes HTML, so without the copy a page's image resolves while the
# tree is served and 404s once the site is deployed.

md2html -html out -html-ext html repo/docs

exists out/index.html
exists out/img/diagram.svg
exists out/robots.txt
exists out/favicon.ico
exists out/css/extra.css

# A docs tree sits inside a repository holding more than a site, so the
# copy is an allowlist: source and configuration stay unpublished.
! exists out/notes.go
! exists out/config.json
! exists out/.hidden/leak.svg

# The ignore file governs assets as it governs pages.
! exists out/planning/sketch.svg

-- repo/.mintignore --
docs/planning/

-- repo/docs/index.md --
# Home

![Diagram](img/diagram.svg)

-- repo/docs/img/diagram.svg --
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1 1"></svg>

-- repo/docs/robots.txt --
User-agent: *

-- repo/docs/favicon.ico --
not really an icon, but the copy does not care

-- repo/docs/css/extra.css --
body { color: red }

-- repo/docs/notes.go --
package notes

-- repo/docs/config.json --
{}

-- repo/docs/.hidden/leak.svg --
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"></svg>

-- repo/docs/planning/sketch.svg --
